description.value: NUTTEA is a Taiwanese-origin specialty café that cold-presses five varieties of real nuts — macadamia, hazelnut, walnut, almond, and cashew — into its signature 'Nut Mylk,' made fresh daily with no preservatives or additives. The entire menu is vegan, pairing nut mylk with teas, fresh fruit drinks, and pour-over coffee options, making it a distinctive and fully plant-based refreshment stop. The West 4th Avenue Vancouver location is part of an international chain spanning Taiwan, Hong Kong, the UK, Australia, and Canada.
